title: MMRel: Benchmarking Relation Understanding in Multi-Modal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the 'Yes-Rate' (Y.R.) on balanced binary Yes/No questions to evaluate the multi-modal large language models' tendency to default to 'yes' responses rather than relying on genuine visual understanding.

Comparing human accuracy against the performance of secondary models (like GPT-4o and Gemini-2.5) on GPT-4V-annotated data subsets to verify if the benchmark's difficulty is genuine or skewed by artifacts from the annotator model.
